items.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: Bill Spilka wrote this article... Bill was reading it to me

ctx.x: So he calls me quite often but he had just picked up this new ITA Journal where I’d gotten a really good review from the Brass Conference. Bill Spilka wrote this article, I mean this is a big — it said that my band, and we followed the One O’Clock North Texas Band. We followed them. And Bill Spilka wrote, it said that this band that Wayne Andre got together, and the music — I haven’t seen the article, Bill was reading it to me — is the best thing that happened at the Brass Conference.
All right. Excellent. © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-
